question:

history.name: Orchestrator

Objective: Determine the average additional cost per over-limit file if upgrading to the minimum plan that can store all files. Steps: 1) Extract plan storage and pricing from the attached image. 2) Compute file size and total storage needed. 3) Identify minimum sufficient plan. 4) Compute price difference vs Standard. 5) Divide by the number of files that exceed Standard's limit and round to nearest cent.

- Advanced: 1 TB (1000 GB), $20/month
- Pro: 2 TB (2000 GB), $30/month
- Business: 5 TB (5000 GB), $40/month
- Enterprise: 10 TB (10000 GB), $70/month
No mention of overage per-GB charges; it appears storage is tiered only.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Thanks. Summary from image: Standard 100 GB at $10; higher tiers up to Business 5 TB at $40. Assistant, please compute: file size from overage, total capacity for 1040 files, minimum plan that fits, number of over-limit files, price difference, per-over-limit-file cost.

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Deriving file size:
Given Standard limit L = 100 GB and after uploading 60 files the user is 100 GB over the limit. Assume initial usage was 0.
Equation: 60 * s − L = 100 => s = (L + 100) / 60 = (100 + 100) / 60 = 200 / 60 ≈ 3.3333 GB per file.

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Total storage needed for all files:
1040 files × 3.3333 GB ≈ 3466.67 GB ≈ 3.47 TB. The minimum plan ≥3.47 TB is Business (5 TB).

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Files covered by Standard vs over-limit:
Max files fitting in Standard = floor(100 GB / 3.3333 GB) = floor(30) = 30 files.
Over-limit files = 1040 − 30 = 1010 files.

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Price difference:
Business $40 − Standard $10 = $30 additional per month.
Average additional cost per over-limit file = $30 / 1010 ≈ $0.0297 → rounded to nearest cent: 0.03.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Good. Please show your formulas explicitly so we can audit the logic before finalizing.

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Formulas:
- File size s = (Standard limit + 100 GB overage) / 60
- Total required GB = 1040 × s
- Choose minimum plan with storage ≥ Total required GB
- Files within Standard = floor(Standard limit / s)
- Over-limit files = 1040 − Files within Standard
- Additional monthly cost = (Price of chosen plan − Price of Standard)
- Average additional cost per over-limit file = Additional monthly cost / Over-limit files, rounded to nearest cent.

Treating the situation as a new interaction, it assumed Standard had 0 GB at $0/month and selected a 2 TB $40 plan, changing both the plan and the denominator to all 1040 files.
